newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel safety cttee to meet Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel safety cttee to meet Tuesday.

text.p: A key committee in charge of safety in the Channel Tunnel is due to meet in London on Tuesday and is expected to make a recommendation to the Inter-Governmental Commission (IGC) on whether to re-open the link for passengers, a French safety official said.
The Channel Tunnel safety authority will convene under the chairmanship of French official Roger Lejuez, after having held talks with Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA/Plc, he said.
The IGC, on the basis of the safety report and results of Sunday's evacuation drill of some 650 people through the Tunnel, will decide on resumption of passenger serviceS.
Only a partial freight rail service has been permitted through the Tunnel since a fire two weeks ago injured 34 people and seriously damaged a section of it.

Eurotunnel staged a drill on Sunday in which around 650 people were evacuated from a train in the Tunnel, walking through the central service tunnel and then taking a train in the adjacant tunnel. The exercise took two hours and 20 minutes.
